newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market down in slow summer trading.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market down in slow summer trading.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter market ended the week lower on Friday, with most high caps under selling pressure in recent days, traders said.
Turnover slipped as Romanians went off on holiday and investors awaited new lows, they added. Cheaper stocks and some newcomers bucked the trend and saw an upturn in activity.
"The market's high caps will continue to see a downtrend over the next week. Turnover is unlikely to rise," one trader said.
Three independent indices, computed by securities companies based on average prices and market capitalisation, fell on Thursday's levels.
The VAB-RA all-share index fell by 2.8 percent to 6,270.8 points, BIG-OTC slid 3.64 percent to 4,615.69 points and CAS-RQ was down 4.45 percent at 990 points.
Cement makers were the biggest losers among high caps, with four giving ground on Friday in low volumes.
Romcim cement maker shed 9,000 lei to close at 103,000, with trading at half its normal daily volumes. Moldocim cement producer also lost 7,500 lei from Thursday's closing price to 42,500 lei.
But traders said new price lows were unlikely to boost turnover in the slow summer period.
Bearings makers also traded lower with supply exceeding demand for Rulmentul Alexandria, which fell 8.34 percent on Thursday's price to 43,000 lei. Oil refineries were also down.
Investors focused on grain traders, which came into the limelight amid expectations of a bumper 1997 wheat crop and opportunities for export.
Gainers outnumbered losers by 202 to 128 on Friday and 238 stocks were flat.
Turnover fell to 16.3 billion lei from 19.5 billion on Thursday.
The VAB-RA index is displayed on VANGUARD and CAS-RQ on CRAS02 and CRAS03. ($=7,285 lei)
